title: Kaplan-Meier plots
text: Kaplan–Meier plots using ggplot2 package, overall Stata-like style. Differences compared survminer::ggsurvplot() include: Transparent pointwise confidence interval simultaneous confidence band areas always drawn behind survival curves never . Censor marks drawn customizable line segments instead point symbols. risk table title spaced uniformly risk table rows. Kaplan–Meier y-axis title remains fixed place, unaffected width risk table labels.

title: Kaplan-Meier plots
text: can install development version ggKaplanMeier GitHub :

title: Kaplan-Meier plots
code: library(ggKaplanMeier) data <- survival::lung fig1a <- ggKM(data$time * 12 / 365.2425, data$status - 1, breaks.t = seq(0, 30, 6),                colors = "#009F6B", risk.table = 1, title.s = "Overall survival", title.t = "Time (months)") print(fig1a) fig1b <- ggKM(data$time * 12 / 365.2425, data$status - 1, data$sex, breaks.t = seq(0, 30, 6),                legend.labels = c("Male", "Female"), title.s = "Overall survival", title.t = "Time (months)") print(fig1b) print(ggKM.surv.extra(fig1b))

what: Example: Dukes stage B/C colon cancer study
title: Kaplan-Meier plots
code: library(ggKaplanMeier) data <- survival::colon fig1 <- ggKM(data$time * 12 / 365.2425, data$status, data$extent,               colors = c("#0087BD", "#009F6B", "#FEA500", "#C40233"),               legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.just = "center",               legend.labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"),               legend.pos = c(0.5, 0.1), risk.table.prop = 0.2,               title.s = "Overall survival", title.t = "Time (months)") print(fig1)

title: Kaplan-Meier plots
code: library(ggKaplanMeier) data <- survival::lung f.custom <- function() {   fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(.time, .status) ~ 1,                             conf.type = "arcsin")   return(data.frame("time" = fit$time, "surv" = fit$surv,                      "lower" = fit$lower, "upper" = fit$upper)) } fig1 <- ggKM(data$time * 12 / 365.2425, data$status - 1, data$sex, CI = f.custom, breaks.t = seq(0, 30, 6),              legend.labels = c("Male", "Female"), title.s = "Overall survival", title.t = "Time (months)") print(fig1)

title: Kaplan–Meier plot — ggKM
text: time Numeric vector follow-times. status Integer vector event indicator (1 = event, 0 = censored). group Optional integer vector grouping variable. breaks.s Y-axis (survival) tick marks. Default = seq(0, 1, 0.25). breaks.t X-axis (time) tick marks. Default = seq(0, max(time), = 12). CI String indicating CI type (custom function; see Details): "none": none Pointwise confidence intervals: "cloglog" (default): Greenwood's variance¹ complementary log–log transformation² "modcloglog": "cloglog" lower confidence limit modified according effective sample size censored observation³ "Rothman": Rothman's binomial method⁴ (via WHKMconf package) "TG": Thomas–Grunkemeier likelihood-ratio method⁵ (via WHKMconf package) "BPCP": beta product confidence procedure⁶ (via bpcp package) Simultaneous confidence bands: "Nair": Nair's log-transformed equal precision method⁷ (via WHKMconf package) "HM": Hollander–McKeague likelihood-ratio method⁸ (via WHKMconf package) CI.alpha Alpha transparency confidence intervals. Default = 0.2. colors Vector colors survival curves. Default = c("#0087BD",  "#C40233", "#009F6B", "#FEA500", "#9755AE", "#33B1BD", "#FFD300", "#D8668B"). digits.fixed Number decimal places risk table weights used. Default = 1. grid.color Gridline color. Default = grDevices::rgb(0.95, 0.95, 0.95). grid.s Horizontal gridline positions. Default = seq(0, 1, 0.25). grid.t Vertical gridline positions. Default = NULL. grid.width Gridline thickness. Default = 0.5. legend.direction Legend orientation; either "vertical" (default) "horizontal". legend.just Alignment anchor legend relative position. Can single keyword (e.g., "center"), keyword pair specifying horizontal vertical justification (e.g., c("left", "top"), c("right", "bottom")) respectively, numeric vector length 2 giving relative coordinates within plot area. Default = c("right", "top"). legend.label.pos Legend label position ("left" "right") relative legend symbol. Default = "left". legend.labels Character vector group labels. legend.ncol Integer specifying number columns legend. Default = NULL. legend.nrow Integer specifying number rows legend. Default = NULL. legend.pos Position legend. Can keyword "none", "left", "right", "bottom", "top", numeric vector length 2 giving relative coordinates within plot area. Default = c(1, 1). Set "none" group NULL. legend.text.align Legend text alignment: 0 = left, 0.5 = center, 1 = right. Default = 1. margin.KM.b Numeric value specifying size Kaplan–Meier plot bottom margin points. Default = 0. margin.KM.l Numeric value specifying size Kaplan–Meier plot left margin points. Default = 0. margin.KM.r Numeric value specifying size Kaplan–Meier plot right margin points. Default = 0. margin.KM.t Numeric value specifying size Kaplan–Meier plot top margin points. Default = 4. margin.risk Numeric value specifying horizontal spacing risk table labels risk table. Default = 16. line.width Line width survival curves censor marks. Default = 0.5. line.height Height censor marks. Default = 0.025. max.t Optional numeric value specifying maximum time Kaplan–Meier plot risk table displayed. risk.table Integer specifying risk table mode: 0: risk table 1: Labelled risk table 2 (default): Color-coded risk table risk.table.prop Relative height risk table. Default = 0.1. t.labels Optional string vector specifying custom labels time-axis breaks defined breaks.t. textsize.axis Axis text size. Default = 12. textsize.legend Legend text size. Default = 12. textsize.risk Risk table text size. Default = 12. title.s Y-axis (survival) title. Default = "Survival". title.t X-axis (time) title. Default = "Time". weights Optional numeric vector observation weights.

code: data <- survival::lung fig1a <- ggKM(data$time * 12 / 365.2425, data$status - 1, data$sex,                breaks.t = seq(0, 30, 6), legend.labels = c("Male", "Female"),               title.s = "Overall survival", title.t = "Time (months)") print(fig1a)  f.custom <- function() {   fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(.time, .status) ~ 1,                              conf.type = "arcsin")   return(data.frame("time" = fit$time, "surv" = fit$surv,                      "lower" = fit$lower, "upper" = fit$upper)) } fig1b <- ggKM(data$time * 12 / 365.2425, data$status - 1, data$sex,                breaks.t = seq(0, 30, 6), legend.labels = c("Male", "Female"),                title.s = "Overall survival", title.t = "Time (months)",                CI = f.custom) print(fig1b)
